packageRules.description: Self-managed image pinned by release workflow — do not auto-update
Must not pass engines.vscode in extensions/vscode/package.json, or the extension will not package — raised by hand, together with that minimum

Follows the oldest Node each project runs on (engines.node at the root, the esbuild target in extensions/vscode/), so the type check rejects an API that Node lacks — raised by hand, together with that minimum
